Sports Club Regular.name: Sports Club Regular
Sports Club Regular.description:
⚽ You practiced every afternoon: track, soccer, volleyball or baseball.

🌅 Early-morning runs and summer camps were part of the deal.
🤝 You know how to play your part on a team.

📈 Grants: Athletics +5, Team Coordination +5
Sports Club Regular.traitNarrativeEffects: The character spent high school in a sports club and still thinks in drills, warm-ups and teamwork. They recover fast, read a team's rhythm and talk easily with athletes; coaches and club captains recognize the type.
